mechaber/1:main.en: The law of chametz belonging to a non-Jew deposited with a Jew — four סעיפים: A non-Jew who deposited his chametz with a Jew: if the Jew is responsible for it in cases of theft or loss—whether it is in his house or anywhere under his domain—he is obligated to remove it.
